name: Field Marshal [Run & Gun]
text: Warbeasts in this model's battlegroup have Run & Gun.

name: Run & Gun
text: After destroying an enemy with a ranged attack, this model may advance its full speed at the end of its activation.

name: Resourceful
text: Upkeep spells this model has running on its own battlegroup cost no fury to keep up.

name: Regeneration [d3]
text: Once per activation, unless it ran this turn, this model may be forced to heal d3 damage.

name: Snacking
text: When this model boxes a living model with a melee attack, it may remove that model from play and heal d3 damage.

name: Dodge
text: When an enemy attack misses this model, it may advance 2 inches after the attack resolves.

name: Leadership [Trollkin Highwaymen]
text: Friendly Trollkin Highwaymen within 10 inches have Dodge.

name: Swift Hunter
text: After a basic ranged attack destroys an enemy, this model may advance 2 inches.

name: Critical Devastation
text: On a critical hit, roll one d6 and throw every model hit that many inches directly away from the attacker, farthest first. Other models in the blast take a POW 8 damage roll.

name: Forced Reload [1]
text: Force this model once to make one more shot with this weapon during the combat action.

name: Guided Fire (extra die)
text: While Guided Fire covers this model, its ranged attack rolls with this weapon use one extra die.

name: Both Barrels
text: Replaces the initial attacks with one attack that adds 4 to its damage roll.

name: Luck
text: Once per attack roll, a missed roll with this weapon is rolled again.
